_note: Badges (sim/systems/badge_system.gd): one-off marks for doing something few do, kept in state.badges. Each has a name, a line for the log, and what earns it: 'visit' (be docked at any of these places), 'visit_all' (have been to all of them), or 'rounds' (have bought a bar this many rounds; 'at' limits it to these places). Each adds 'renown', and may add 'rep' with operators. Renown gets you noticed: each point raises the chance a hitchhiker asks at a port and a client approaches you by name, by the fractions in 'renown', up to max_mult times the usual chance. Buying a round costs a bar's patrons times its round_cr, and adds round_rep with the bar's operator.

past_the_point.name: Past the Point
past_the_point.text: Rode the Luna Line out beyond L1 to Ballast Point, and stood on the ceiling.

the_end.name: The End
the_end.text: Climbed the Piazzi Stalk to Stalk Top and signed under the sign.

far_side_of_up.name: The Far Side of Up
far_side_of_up.text: Rode the Pavonis Line out to its counterweight.

ballast_collector.name: Ballast Collector
ballast_collector.text: Has stood at the top of every elevator in the system.

under_earth.name: Under Earth
under_earth.text: Rode down to Line Foot and saw Earth hang still overhead.

belter.name: Belter
belter.text: Docked at Psyche Claims, a long way from anywhere.

trojan_horse.name: Trojan Horse
trojan_horse.text: Reached Hektor, out among the Trojans.

drinks_on_the_ribbon.name: Drinks on the Ribbon
drinks_on_the_ribbon.text: Bought the Counterweight Bar a round, 82,000 km above the Moon.

regular.name: Regular
regular.text: Has bought ten rounds. People save you a seat.
